clue.text: Tree very much planted in more than one area

indicators.note: something planted in soil sits inside it, so these letters are set between the outer pair

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for area, taken twice
as in 'far better', meaning by a great deal

explanation.surface: A tree that has been widely planted across several regions.
explanation.walkthrough: The two A's from 'more than one area' go round FAR: A-FAR-A.
explanation.definitionFit: Afara is a West African hardwood timber tree, also called limba.

clue.text: On air broadcast has split account of the priesthood

indicators.note: seed that is broadcast is scattered about, so the letters are scattered into a new order
the scrambled letters have split the abbreviation, sitting between its two halves

parts.note: AC is the standard abbreviation for account
the five letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A radio programme splits its story of the clergy into parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Aaron was the first Jewish high priest, so Aaronic describes the priesthood descended from him.

clue.text: Ran away from local flat

definitions.meaning: first meaning: past tense of fly, as in fled
second meaning: a dialect adjective meaning shallow or flat

explanation.surface: Someone fled from the neighbourhood apartment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Local' marks a dialect word: Chambers gives flew, a variant of flue, as a regional word for shallow or flat. The surface makes 'flat' an apartment.
explanation.definitionFit: To fly can mean to flee, and the dialect adjective describes something shallow or level.

clue.text: Understand a Catholic church point

parts.note: taken as written
C is the abbreviation for Catholic
CE is the Church of England
PT is the abbreviation for point

explanation.surface: Someone grasps a doctrinal point of the Catholic church.
explanation.definitionFit: To accept an idea is to take it in and believe it, close to grasping it.

clue.text: Pewterer's blowpipe, one in strange metal

indicators.note: the tool and the numeral are placed inside the word for odd

parts.note: rum means odd or peculiar
Chambers gives hod as a pewterer's blowpipe
Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A metalworker's blowpipe is a curious piece of metal.
explanation.walkthrough: HOD here is not the builder's brick carrier but an obscure pewterer's tool.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhodium is a hard silvery element of the platinum group.

clue.text: Returning north I take second grade antimalarial

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, so the whole string reads right to left

parts.note: N is the abbreviation for north
taken as written
R stands for recipe, Latin for take, on prescriptions
beta is the second-class mark, after alpha

explanation.surface: Coming back from the north, someone takes a second-rate malaria drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Atebrin is a trade name for mepacrine, a synthetic drug once widely used against malaria.

clue.text: Absurd alarm about Military Intelligence officer in the past

indicators.note: something absurd makes no sense, so the letters are jumbled into a new order
about means around, so the jumbled letters surround the intelligence abbreviation

parts.note: the five letters rearranged
MI is the usual abbreviation

explanation.surface: A ridiculous panic surrounds an intelligence officer of former times.
explanation.definitionFit: Ammiral is an obsolete form of admiral, a senior naval commander.

clue.text: Eastern open country antelopes eating a small tree

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for eastern

indicators.note: something eating takes food inside it, so the word for meadow swallows the single letter

parts.note: a lea is open grassland or meadow
taken as written
gnus are wildebeest, a kind of antelope

explanation.surface: Antelopes on eastern grasslands browse a little tree.
explanation.walkthrough: A goes inside LEA, after its first letter, giving L-A-EA.
explanation.definitionFit: Elaeagnus is a genus of shrubs and small trees, including oleaster and silverberry.

clue.text: One giving help over a form of parasite

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means turned upside down, so the word reads from the bottom

parts.note: someone who aids

explanation.surface: A helper is, in a sense, a kind of parasite.
explanation.definitionFit: A redia is a larval stage of a fluke, a parasitic flatworm living inside snails.

clue.text: Badly tempered copper put in current gold coin

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current

indicators.note: the metal symbol is placed inside the coin's name

parts.note: the rand is South Africa's currency, named after the gold-bearing Witwatersrand
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: Copper badly tempered when put into a current gold coin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Badly tempered' reads like a metallurgy defect, but it means irritable.
explanation.definitionFit: Iracund comes from Latin iracundus and means prone to anger, irascible.

clue.text: Tongue rook kept inside beak

indicators.note: the chess letter is held within the word for beak

parts.note: beak is slang for nose
R is the chess notation for rook

explanation.surface: A bird's tongue and its beak, with a rook in the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Tongue here means a language; Norse is the old Scandinavian language.

clue.text: Revolutionary in aluminium, my old trumpet

indicators.note: the revolutionary is placed inside the other two pieces

parts.note: Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium
Che Guevara, the archetypal revolutionary
taken as written

explanation.surface: A revolutionary sounds an old trumpet made of aluminium.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer's familiar sense is the transmutation of metals; the definition uses a rare obsolete sense, alchemy being a metal alloy from which trumpets were made.
explanation.definitionFit: Chambers and Spenser use alchemy for a trumpet, from the brass-like alloy it was made of.

clue.text: Cipher Joby made to shift alphabetically

indicators.note: each letter is moved the same number of places along the alphabet, as in a Caesar code

parts.note: each letter moved sixteen places on: J to Z, O to E, B to R, Y wrapping round to O

explanation.surface: Someone called Joby has his name encoded by shifting its letters.
explanation.walkthrough: The shift is the same for every letter, a Caesar cipher, which neatly matches the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A cipher is the figure nought, the symbol for nothing.

clue.text: Regular features of green conservation survey

indicators.note: regular features are evenly spaced letters, taking every other one

parts.note: the second and fourth letters
the abbreviation, as in Con for conservative

explanation.surface: Environmental conservation surveys are a regular feature.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay is loose: alternate letters of green, then a clipped start of conservation.
explanation.definitionFit: Recon is short for reconnaissance, a scouting survey of ground or enemy positions.

clue.text: Radical head backed Indian leader

indicators.note: backed means put in reverse, so the joined words read right to left

parts.note: rad is short for radical, a political extremist
a ras is a headland or cape, and also an Ethiopian chief

explanation.surface: A radical chief was supported by an Indian leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Sardar is a title in India and Pakistan for a chief, commander or nobleman.

clue.text: Liverworts pa planted apart during warmth and coldness

indicators.note: the two letters are set separately, one inside each of the two words that follow

parts.note: heat means warmth
taken as written, then split into its two letters
ice stands for coldness

explanation.surface: Father plants liverworts some distance apart in warm and cold spots.
explanation.walkthrough: P goes into HEAT and A into ICE, giving HE-P-AT and IC-A-E.
explanation.definitionFit: Hepaticae is the botanical class name for the liverworts, small flat moss-like plants.

clue.text: Pacific theological system is nicer somehow

indicators.note: somehow means in some unknown manner, so the letters fall into an unspecified order

parts.note: the seven letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A peaceable religious doctrine is somewhat kinder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pacific' looks like the ocean, but it means peace-making.
explanation.definitionFit: Irenics is the branch of theology that seeks reconciliation and unity between Christian churches.

clue.text: Like natural logs not available from area of Mount Olympus

parts.note: NA is the abbreviation for not available
Pieria is the district around Mount Olympus, home of the Muses

explanation.surface: Natural logs cannot be found in the forests around Olympus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Natural logs' suggests timber, but means natural logarithms.
explanation.definitionFit: Napierian logarithms, named after John Napier, are the natural logarithms to base e.

clue.text: Substance offence in a good place

parts.note: quid is the essence or whatness of a thing, a philosophical term
a sin is a moral offence

explanation.surface: A drugs offence leaves someone in a fine position.
explanation.definitionFit: Quids in is British slang for being well off or in a profitable position.

clue.text: Currency Turkish chief's introduced following backing at home

indicators.note: the chief's title has a letter introduced into it

parts.note: an agha is an Ottoman commander or chief
F is the abbreviation for following

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the word for at home is read right to left

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A Turkish leader's currency is brought in with support from home.
explanation.definitionFit: The afghani is the monetary unit of Afghanistan.

clue.text: Walk round in Faeroe Islands with old couple

indicators.note: the round letter sits inside the islands' code

parts.note: FO is the international code for the Faeroe Islands
O is round in shape
tway is an obsolete form of twain, two

explanation.surface: An elderly pair take a walk around the Faeroe Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: A footway is a path for pedestrians, a walk.

clue.text: Beatnik, he trips out

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters are put into another order

parts.note: the seven letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A beatnik goes off on a psychedelic trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Hipster was the 1940s and 50s name for a jazz-loving bohemian, close kin to the beatnik.

clue.text: Gets a whiff of uncovered language of Sri Lanka

indicators.note: uncovered means with its covering removed, so the outer letters are stripped away

parts.note: the majority language of Sri Lanka

explanation.surface: Someone catches the scent of Sri Lanka's language laid bare.
explanation.definitionFit: To inhale is to breathe in, which is how one catches a smell.

clue.text: I'm adult taken in by Christian Union — look who suffers

parts.note: CU is the abbreviation for Christian Union
taken as written, without the apostrophe
A is the film certificate for adult
lo is an old exclamation meaning look

explanation.surface: A grown-up is drawn into a student Christian group, and look who pays for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in by' reads as a container signal, but the pieces simply follow on.
explanation.definitionFit: Cui malo is Latin for 'to whose harm?', the question of who is the loser by a deed.

clue.text: What may terminate thread? Hit transmit soundly

indicators.note: soundly means by sound, so the words are judged as they are spoken

parts.note: whacks means hits
the S of whacks runs on into send

explanation.surface: A hit sent soundly might snap a thread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whacks send' said aloud runs together as the two-word answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A waxed end is a shoemaker's thread stiffened with wax, so it may literally be the end of thread.

clue.text: Pole — also known as stilt in NZ

parts.note: Po is used as a short form of Polish
aka is the standard abbreviation

explanation.surface: A pole, otherwise called a stilt in New Zealand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' and 'stilt' both suggest wooden posts, but the stilt is a wading bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Poaka is the Maori name for the pied stilt, a long-legged New Zealand wading bird.

clue.text: Lighter aquatic mammal lacking height, unknown previously

indicators.note: previously means earlier, so the unknown goes in front

parts.note: z is a mathematical unknown

indicators.note: lacking means without, so a letter is dropped from the animal

parts.note: the river-dwelling hippopotamus
H is the abbreviation for height

explanation.surface: A slimmer hippo, short on height, was once a mystery creature.
explanation.definitionFit: Zippo is a trademark windproof petrol cigarette lighter.

clue.text: What might Cupar host serve up?

definitions.text: What might Cupar host serve up?

indicators.note: serving up a dish involves dishing out and arranging, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the nine letters rearranged

explanation.surface: What a host in Cupar might offer a guest.
explanation.walkthrough: Cupar is a town in Fife, Scotland, so a Scots word for the hospitable offering fits the whole clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Stroupach is a Scots word for a cup of tea, just what a Scottish host would serve.

clue.text: Pagan poet embracing northern independence

parts.note: a writer of odes
N is the abbreviation for northern
I is the abbreviation for independent

explanation.surface: A heathen poet takes up the cause of northern independence.
explanation.definitionFit: An Odinist worships Odin and the old Norse gods, a modern heathen.

clue.text: Caught hole in one on going over pouches from abroad

explanation.definitionFit: The ceca are blind-ended pouches of the gut, the American spelling of caeca.

clue.text: Way of viewing warped space and time

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: What holds swimming pike?

parts.note: the four letters rearranged

clue.text: Glazed pottery thrown out in English café

parts.note: taken as written
E is the abbreviation for English
taken as written

clue.text: Some eating nothing, concerned with variable former lack of appetite

indicators.note: eating means taking inside, so the outer word swallows the rest

parts.note: any means some, as in 'have you any?'
O is a zero
re means about or concerning
x is the algebraic variable

explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' and 'eating nothing' both look like part of the definition, but they are wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Anorexy is an obsolete form of anorexia, a loss of appetite.

clue.text: Prayer Dalradians regularly expressed

parts.note: the second, fourth, sixth, eighth and tenth letters

explanation.definitionFit: Ardas is the formal Sikh prayer recited at the end of services.
